claims.quote: In our cohort, >50% of patients manifested focal epilepsies, which are thus a frequent feature of SCN1A pathogenic variants beyond DS and GEFS+.
Functional studies of three representative variants showed a gain of channel function.
Sodium channel blockers never worsened seizures, and 50% of patients experienced long periods of seizure freedom.
Alternatively, non-DS/non-GEFS+ phenotypes might be associated with gain of channel function, and sodium channel blockers could control seizures by counteracting excessive channel function.
